activity.title: Source Control
state.empty.title: No local repository

state.unborn.message: This local repository has no commits yet. Publish its first commit to a remote repository when you are ready.
state.noWorkspace.title: No local workspace
state.noWorkspace.message: Open a local workspace, then refresh source control.
state.gitUnavailable.title: Git is unavailable
state.gitUnavailable.message: Git is not installed or cannot be used on this device. Install Git and refresh.
state.remoteInvalid.title: Remote repository address is invalid
state.remoteInvalid.message: Enter a valid HTTPS or SSH remote repository address, then try again.
state.remoteFailed.title: Unable to clone the remote repository
state.remoteFailed.message: The local Git service could not clone this remote repository. Check the address and local credentials, then refresh.
state.workspaceNotEmpty.title: The local workspace is not empty
state.workspaceNotEmpty.message: Clone uses an empty local workspace only. Choose an empty workspace and refresh.
state.operationFailed.title: Local source-control operation failed
state.operationFailed.message: The operation could not be completed in the local workspace. Refresh and try again.
state.identityRequired.title: Git author identity is required
state.identityRequired.message: Set local Git user.name and user.email, then try again.
state.nothingToCommit.title: There are no changes to commit
state.nothingToCommit.message: Add or edit a local file before creating a commit.

form.publish.title: Initialize and publish this workspace
form.commit.title: Commit staged changes
form.checkout.title: Checkout a local branch
form.createBranch.title: Create a local branch
form.deleteBranch.title: Delete a local branch
form.fetch.title: Fetch from remote
form.pull.title: Pull from remote
form.push.title: Push to remote

state.noRemote: No remote configured. Add one from the menu.

state.authenticationRequired.title: Git authentication required
state.authenticationRequired.message: Configure a local credential helper or SSH agent, then retry. Interactive prompts are unavailable.
state.conflict.title: Changes need attention
state.conflict.message: Resolve conflicts or local changes before retrying. Review the files below.
state.branchCheckedOut.title: Branch is checked out

state.remoteUnavailable.title: Remote is unavailable
state.remoteUnavailable.message: The remote is missing or uses an unsupported address. Add or update it in the menu.

notice.fetchComplete: Fetch completed. Ahead and behind counts use the fetched references.
detail.untracked: This is an untracked file. Stage it to review its patch.
detail.empty: No text patch is available for this file.
state.outcomeUnknown.title: Result needs verification
state.outcomeUnknown.message: Git timed out. The local or remote operation may have completed; refresh and verify its state before retrying.
state.publishPartial: The first local commit was created; remote publication is not confirmed.

state.refreshAfterSuccess.message: Git completed the operation, but the view could not be refreshed. Refresh and verify the result before retrying.
